Draw a straight pedestrian shopping street at night, seen exactly from the eye height of a standing person, the camera 1.4 metres above the pavement and pointing perfectly horizontally straight down the middle of the street. It is a flat, level, symmetrical one-point perspective: all the lines of the street converge to a single vanishing point at the exact horizontal centre of the image. The wet stone pavement fills the entire lower half of the image, wide and empty, with a few puddles. The grey shop buildings on both sides (4 to 6 floors, glass shop windows on the ground floor, large blank glowing holographic billboards on the upper floors, street lamps) converge toward the centre, and the sky is a narrow dark strip above the far end of the street. The whole picture is completely greyscale with no colour at all, and tiny raindrops hang motionless in the air as small dots. A very few small grey statue-like pedestrians stand far away near the sides of the street, none near the camera and none in the middle of the street. A lane of small grey wheel-less hover cars hangs motionless in the air high above the middle of the street, in a row, the nearest ones about 8 percent of the image width wide and each one farther down the street smaller than the one before. At the very end of the street, at the vanishing point, there is a tiny patch of colourful neon lights in magenta, cyan and amber. There is no tower, no robot, no drone and no character. Clean Japanese anime cel shading with thin black line art, flat colors, anime background art. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
